title: Launching Sora responsibly
summary: To address the novel safety challenges posed by a state-of-the-art video model as well as a new social creation platform, we’ve built Sora 2 and the Sora app with safety at the foundation. Our approach is anchored in concrete protections.
body: To address the novel safety challenges posed by a state-of-the-art video model as well as a new social creation platform, we’ve built Sora 2 and the Sora app with safety at the foundation. Our approach is anchored in concrete protections.
summaryZh: 为应对最先进视频生成模型及社交创作平台带来的新型安全挑战，OpenAI发布了Sora 2及配套应用。新模型在保障安全底线的基础上构建，采取了一系列具体的保护措施，标志着视频AI生成技术正走向更成熟的商用与社区生态。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI正式推出Sora 2及社交应用并公布安全应对策略，是多模态视频生成模型的重要发布。
